summary: Iteration 13 tests for PayPal (config + create-order), Social Studio image overlay end-to-end (backend + frontend), captions field schema acceptance, and Pricing PayPal render. 9 backend tests pass (1 skipped by design when no ready cut exists). Frontend Pricing PayPal buttons render for Creator plan; admin's own Studio plan correctly shows 'Current plan' instead of a PayPal container. Full Social Studio overlay flow works: plan generation, AI image design, opening Social Image Editor modal, applying text overlay, and image update.
critical_code_review_comments: payments.py: _token() uses blocking requests inside an async endpoint (also in create_order/capture) — under load this will block the FastAPI event loop. Consider httpx.AsyncClient or run_in_executor.

payments.py: capture() upgrades the user's plan but does not enforce that the captured amount == expected plan amount (only checks status==COMPLETED). A tampered/altered PayPal order could theoretically be captured — verify data['purchase_units'][0]['payments']['captures'][0]['amount']['value'] server-side.
social.py get_design: builds import via __import__('asyncio') at line 149 while asyncio is already imported at line 162 inside overlay_design; cleanup for consistency.
SocialImageEditor apply flow: overlay POST does not include cache-busting — verified working via ?ts= in imgUrl, but ensure the reused src refresh path always invalidates cache.
seed_data_creation: Social plan + posts + AI-generated designs + overlay images were created under user_admin_seed as part of the flow tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: PayPal sandbox credentials are wired and returning real sandbox order ids (49 for creator/monthly, 1428 for studio/yearly). Social Studio route is /social (not /social-studio). Admin is on studio plan so the Studio card shows 'Current plan' — that's expected; to test paypal-studio render, use a non-studio account. Captions field acceptance for /api/cuts/{id}/pro-edit was SKIPPED because no ready cut exists for admin; video job caption schema test passed. Editor captions data-testids exist in CutEditor.jsx (cut-captions-toggle) and VideoEditor.jsx (editor-captions-toggle) — I did not exercise those UI modals as they require navigating to a ready cut/DONE video job.
